title: EnchantEveryTicks
description: "Enchant Every Ticks" gameplay running on Fabric
body:
**A mod that supports the high version 1.21.8 with 
the "Enchant Every Ticks" gameplay inspired by "[Minecraft but you Enchant every Second](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/op-dirt-revamped/)" 
by Bittu5134. Hope you enjoy it.**

Theoretically supports versions around 1.21!

## Features
- Every 5 seconds, randomly enchant all items of all players.
- If the selected enchantment does not exist, apply level 1; 
- if it exists, increase the level by 1.
